name: Synchronized registries with data for clients without the vanilla pack
note: Removed with the first generation's server (tag pre-refactor) in the restructuring of 2026-11; returns with VIEW1, NET1. First generation: Each bundle names its registry set: 17 registries for 1.21.8 and 11 for 1.21.4 sent by name to clients with the vanilla pack, the same entries as the official servers; clients without the pack get a documented minimal set with data; its deviations: 1.21.8 dialogs and game-test registries are not sent; clients without the vanilla pack get only dimension types, plains and the chat type with data; enchantments are sent only with the official jar's data pack
